## [2.0] - Tools
### [2.1]: What is a tool?

The Human Ability to build things that far exceed our Anatomical capacities... arguably, it is largely our Cognitive faculties which extend the Physical world, into abstract space (Imagination), and back into the Physical world as extensions.

### [2.2] Tool-making Biology

In Biology, Several Vertebrates (Ravens, Apes, etc.) and Invertebrates (Octopus) have been shown to use tools; Some Animals understand how to use the Physical world
